ev.q: During 2000–2016, estimated MCV1 coverage increased from 74% to 94%.

This report describes progress and challenges toward measles elimination in Bangladesh during 2000–2016.

methods_quotes.q: Administrative vaccination coverage is the number of vaccine doses administered divided by the estimated target population.
Measles incidence calculated based on reported confirmed measles cases and population by countries through WHO/UNICEF JRF.
WHO and UNICEF use reported administrative coverage and available survey results to generate annual estimates of vaccination coverage through routine services
